app.name: AlgoVerse
app.tagline: A visual lab for learning data structures and algorithms

topbar.previewHint: Screens are placeholders while each section is built

theme.label: Theme
theme.shortcutHint: Ctrl + Alt + T toggles light and dark

account.guestHint: Your progress is saved in this browser

placeholder.stageBody: This screen's features arrive in phase {{phase}}. The navigation, themes and layout around it are already in place.

dashboard.description: Your home base: what to learn next, today's goal and your progress at a glance.
planned: Continue where you left off
Recommendations that explain why
Daily goal, streak and milestones

universe.description: Explore every topic as a tile on a triangular map, and see how each one unlocks the next.
planned: Zoom from the whole pyramid down to single concepts
See which tiles are open, in progress or mastered
A list view for keyboard and screen-reader users

curriculum.description: Browse the full course from tier to tile to concept, with time estimates and your status.
planned: Filter by thread, kind, status and maturity
Estimated time for every concept
The linear, scannable twin of the Universe

algorithms.description: Run any algorithm on your own inputs and watch it work, one step at a time.
planned: Explore: the full player with free inputs
Time Machine: scrub, jump and compare any two steps
Battle Arena: race algorithms on the same data

structures.description: Build data structures by hand and watch their invariants hold, or break.
planned: A canvas for nodes, pointers and buckets
A live Python view that round-trips your edits
Animated insert, delete, search and traverse

playground.description: Write Python in your browser, then run it, visualize it or step through it.
planned: Run, Visualize and Debug with step-back
Examples to start from, saved in this browser
Console, inspector and output side by side

problems.description: Practise on problems matched to what you have learned, with hints when you need them.
planned: About 20 problems for Pyramid I
Hints revealed one at a time
Pattern Trainer: spot the right approach first

projects.description: Build real systems, such as a search engine, from the structures you have mastered.
planned: Architecture diagrams and milestone plans
Starter code and tests for every milestone
Visualizations of each system's core structure

progress.description: See your mastery, streaks, badges and review schedule in one place.
planned: A pyramid heat map of mastery by tile
XP history and a streak calendar
Every concept with its next review date

library.description: Look up any concept, complexity or term without starting a lesson.
planned: Condensed concept pages with code
Complexity cheat sheets and a glossary
Search across everything

settings.description: Tune AlgoVerse to the way you like to learn.
planned: Motion, playback speed and step granularity
Daily goal and keyboard shortcuts
Export, import or delete your data

lesson.description: Every concept is taught in 12 short sections, from intuition to code to checkpoint.
planned: A visualization stage beside live code
Predict-the-next-step moments
A checkpoint that proves mastery

dashboard.intro: Your learning lab is being assembled. These cards preview what your dashboard will show.

continue.title: Continue learning
continue.body: Your next lesson will appear here. Everyone starts with “What is an Algorithm?” at the top of Pyramid I.

goal.title: Daily goal
goal.body: Earn XP by predicting, practising and passing checkpoints. Watching alone earns none.

pyramid.title: Your pyramid
pyramid.body: Pyramid I has 4 tiles. You have started 0.

next.title: Recommended next
next.body: Suggestions tailored to you, each with the reason it was picked.

algorithm.intro: Every algorithm AlgoVerse will teach. Open one to see what will be built for it and a tiny example worked by hand.

structure.intro: Every data structure AlgoVerse will teach. Open one to see what will be built for it and a tiny example worked by hand.
